description: This file contains test cases for the script 'run-vitest-profile.mjs'. It tests functions that build command line arguments for profiling with Vitest, resolve output directories, and parse command-line arguments. The tests use the 'vitest' testing framework and interact with external modules for filesystem operations, path resolution, and script functionalities.

methods.name: resolveVitestProfileDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory for Vitest profiling output based on mode and output directory.

methods.name: buildVitestProfileCommand
methods.description: Builds the command and arguments to run Vitest profiling in different modes.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine mode and output directory.
